'''Andilay root '''is helpful for fatigue. It "clear[s] the head and dint[s] the burn in tired muscles." {{ref/book|1|18}}{{ref/book|3|48}}

During the [[Last Battle]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] successfully used andilay root and simple stitches to help the ailing [[Alanna Mosvani]], whom [[Moridin]] had captured and stabbed inside the [[Pit of Doom]] to make [[Rand al'Thor]] go into the Warder rage upon her death. Thanks to Nynaeve's healing methods, by many a [[Yellow Ajah|Yellow]] sister derogatively referred to as "primitive", she was able to prevent Alanna's immediate death.{{ref/book|14|36}}
